description: See what is on the page: text plus stable element refs for click/type/fill_form. Default filter 'interactive' lists actionable elements; for paragraphs or table cells call view_page(ref, filter: 'all'). Collapsed containers show as [eXX role, N items] — expand with view_page(ref: 'eXX', filter: 'all').

depth.description: Tree levels shown; indentation only, hidden sections need a click

filter.description: interactive | all | landmark | visual (bounds, click point, visibility)

max_tokens.description: Token budget; content downsampled. Omit for full output

name: view_page
